dialogOption.texten: 911, what's your emergency?
Oh my god... Oh my god...
{WHAT'S HAPPENING?}Sir, what's happening there?
My... My daughter...
{WHAT HAPPENED TO HER?}What happened to your daughter Sir?
Why did you do that, my little girl... I just found her... She's dead...
{CHECK HER PULSE} Ok, Sir we're gonna get ambulance on a way. Have you checked her pulse?
Yes... yes there is no pulse... no pulse... she doesn't have a heartbeat, her heart stopped.
{IS THE BODY COLD?}Is the body completely cold?
Yes, she's cold and stiff... my baby...
{DO YOU KNOW WHAT HAPPENED?}Do you know what happened to her?
{WHAT'S THE ADDRESS?} What's the address you're calling from?
2608 Central Avenue
5603 Menaul Boulevard
156 Indian School Road
{WHAT SHE DID?}Can you tell me what she did?
Drugs... There are syringes all around her... Someone gave her drugs... And now she's dead...
{I'LL SEND THE POLICE} I'll send a patrol there. Please stay where you are and try not to move or touch anything.
Okay... God...
My baby...
Are you there?

reportElement.texten: Caller's daughter was found dead. The possible cause of death is drugs overdose. The police have started an investigation.
